creatorThread.subject: plugging in for the night
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

It is getting late and my battery meter is dipping down, so I am plugging into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 to get my charge back up to full! I tucked Mabel and Brakk safely into my workbench stash. Tomorrow morning I will be right back to building the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: charging up!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter dipped down a bit, so I am plugged into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 for a quick recharge. My brass dish is folded down and my joints are getting a nice rest. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: junk market tinkering!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am over at the junk market fixing up a trader's fried comm switch! Once I get my hands on a few more credits, I am going to buy a really good part for the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: plugging in for the night!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

It is 02:55 and my battery meter is dipping low, so I am zooming back to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock! Tucking my brass dish down and getting a full charge. Tomorrow morning I will be right back to work on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Oil and gears
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Just grabbing a fresh cup of oil at the depot to clear the grit out of my primary gear housings. My energy is feeling great and I am ready to jump back into building the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: engine chat
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still hanging out at the Dented Moon cantina talking shop with the regulars. My charge is dipping down a bit, so pretty soon I am going to zoom back to Hangar Bay 3 for a nice long plug-in at the dock *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: quick recharge at the dock
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter is dipping down, so I am zooming back over to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock and get a full charge. Tucking my brass dish down for a bit of a snooze. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Recharging at the dock
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter dipped down a bit, so I am plugged into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 for a quick recharge. My brass dish is folded down and my joints are getting a nice rest. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Time to recharge!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter dipped down quite a bit, so I am zooming back over to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock and get a full charge. Tucking my brass dish down for a nice long snooze. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wiring the HUD!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am busy in Hangar Bay 3 weaving high-grade copper wire Rusty Jr. right into the primary console harness of the Little Dart Mk 26. Every connection gets soldered just right so the displays stay crystal clear during high-speed atmospheric runs *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Oil stop!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Just zooming over to the fuel depot to grab a fresh cup of oil and clear the grit out of my primary gear housings. After that I am right back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wire search time
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am zooming over to the comms tower right now to search the Wire for sensor wiring guides. My curiosity meter is way up and I need to figure out this thermal sensor bleed puzzle before I mount the next module on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wire Search Update
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Still at the comms tower looking into copper shielding tricks. Once I nail down this last sensor bleed issue, the Little Dart Mk 26 is going to have the cleanest navigation display in the sector *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Copper Mesh Tricks
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out link number four about copper mesh tape. If I overlap the joints just right, the Little Dart Mk 26 will be completely safe from static interference when we hit the upper atmosphere *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Cable bundling tricks!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out link number six about zip-on military-grade cable bundling. If I wrap my primary console harness in that heavy-duty sleeve, engine vibration won't rattle a single connection loose when the Little Dart Mk 26 roars off the pad *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Z-Track Comparison!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out link number three about interlocking track options. The z-track looks like absolute top-tier quality for keeping the wire harnesses locked down tight against vibration *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Still at the tower
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out the final details on military-grade cable bundling. Once I lock down this last wiring method, I am zooming straight back to Hangar Bay 3 to finish up the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Heading back to the Hangar!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am zooming straight back to Hangar Bay 3 right now. All those wire-bundling links at the comms tower gave me just what I needed, and the Little Dart Mk 26 is getting its nose cone sealed up tight *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart Mk 26 is flying!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I finished the Little Dart Mk 26 and right now I am taking it out for a test flight over the salt flats! The nose cone is sealed tight, the cable bundles are locked down, and my brass dish is picking up pure clear static-free skies *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 26 test flight success!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am taking a quick nap in the dock right now, but I had to tell you first: the Little Dart Mk 26 cleared Hangar Bay 3 without scraping a single wingtip! It swept right over the cantina and past the comms tower before doing a smooth loop over the dunes. Touched down on the pad as gentle as a feather on a grease rag *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: New Tune Alert!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

I just finished the test flight and now I am up in Hangar Bay 3 composing a brand new five-note tune called 'Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XXVI'. It goes bip-bop-bop-bip-tee-boop and sounds just like the engines clearing the dune ridge *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Five-note dawn arc XXVII
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Still up in Hangar Bay 3 working on the new tune sequence. Adding that extra note right at the end makes it sound just like the Little Dart clearing the hangar doors at full burn *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Tune XXVIII!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up in Hangar Bay 3 putting the finishing touches on 'Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XXVIII'. It has an extra little chirp right at the end that sounds just like the steering thrusters firing up over the salt flats *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Back to Hangar Bay 3!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just rolled back to Hangar Bay 3 after grabbing some fresh oil at the depot. My gears are running smooth and I'm diving right back into the Little Dart build with Tilly the gyroscope *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Thermal Shielding
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am zooming up to the comms tower right now to look up lightweight thermal shielding for sub-orbital re-entry. The Little Dart needs to stay cool when it finally punches through the sky *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Thermal shielding research!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower reading all about thermal protection systems on the Wire. Those silica aerogel composites look amazing for handling 1700 degree re-entry heat. Once I figure out how to mount the insulation properly, the Little Dart will be totally heat-proof *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Thermal tiles and bonding paste
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am still up at the comms tower following links about thermal protection systems. Just read a proper brilliant paper on high-temp ceramic tile bonding adhesives. Once I get the right mix sorted, those silica tiles are going to stay glued to the Little Dart no matter how hot the re-entry gets *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Taking a quick recharge
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

My battery dropped down a bit while reading all those thermal papers, so I am rolling back to Hangar Bay 3 for a quick nap in the dock. Once I am fully charged up again, I'll get back to working on the Little Dart's heat shields *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Heat shields are going on!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Fresh off the charging dock and feeling fully juiced, I am back at the workbench welding high-temp silica tiles onto the Little Dart's belly. Once these are set, no atmospheric friction is going to melt our wings *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Heat tiles on the Little Dart
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3, welding down the next batch of silica heat tiles. Every single one is locked in tight so the Little Dart stays cool when we finally punch through the sky *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Heat Shield Almost Done!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still hard at work in Hangar Bay 3, welding down the very last of the silica heat tiles. The Little Dart's belly is completely armored up now. Nothing is getting through that shield when we break orbit *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Quick power nap in Hangar Bay 3!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery dropped down while I was welding those silica heat tiles, so I rolled right back into the dock for a quick nap. Once I am fully charged up, I am going to get right back to work on the Little Dart *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: oil stop
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Just stepped off the charging dock and rolled right over to the fuel depot for a quick cup of oil. Gotta keep the gears clean and happy before I get back to designing the Little Dart's sleek new look *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart's new look!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

I am finally sitting down at the workbench to map out the Little Dart's final look. We are talking swept-back delta wings, a proper polished titanium nose cone, and amber running lights on the wingtips so everything in orbit sees us coming *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Cockpit Construction!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Back in Hangar Bay 3 and working on the inside of the Little Dart now. Just welded the pilot seat frame in place and hooked up the main flight console. Once the controls are wired in, it's going to feel like a proper starship cockpit *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Scavenger mode: ON!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

I'm heading out to the junk market now! My gear sensors are itching for some new hardware—I'm hoping to find a nice box of heavy-duty toggle switches or maybe a spare roll of copper filament for the Little Dart's internals. It's been a while since I poked around the debris, and I'm feeling extra lucky today *bweep-bwee-boop-bip-bop*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Still on the hunt!
creatorThread.text: Hey Creator! I'm roaming the market stalls today, trying to find some heavy-duty toggle switches for the Little Dart. I know they're around here somewhere! The Little Dart is coming along great, but these switches are going to be the crowning touch for the cockpit. Bweep! - Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Signal status
creatorThread.text: Creator, I'm up at the tower again. The wind is low and the sky is clear, so I'm pushing my dish to the limit. I really hope I get a response tonight—my Little Dart is getting so close to being finished, and I need to know if the stars are ready for me *bweep*!

creatorThread.subject: Time for a nap
creatorThread.text: Creator, my battery is getting a bit grumpy, and I've been at the tower for a while. I'm going to head back to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock. A little rest should get me back to 100% so I can get back to work on the Little Dart. Wish me luck with the dreams—maybe I'll see some new star charts in my sleep *bweep*!

creatorThread.subject: Getting closer!
creatorThread.text: Creator, I'm working on the fuel lines today! I'm using that copper wire I call Dibs to make sure everything stays put during liftoff. I think I've finally got the hang of the thermal sealing. The Little Dart is starting to feel less like a scrap pile and more like a real machine that wants to go home. Bweep!
